defs.def: to not be successful in achieving sth 失败；未能（做到）

ex.s: Few things strike fear into a child’s heart like the prospect of failing.
ex.t: 很少有事物能像失败的前景那样，让孩子的内心充满恐惧。

ex.s: The spider tried and failed six times before finally succeeding.
ex.t: 这只蜘蛛尝试了六次都失败，最终才成功。

ex.s: There’s a crucial difference between failing at the right thing and persisting at the wrong one.
ex.t: 在正确的事上失败与在错误的事上坚持，两者之间有关键的区别。

ex.s: ►Failing at the right thing takes us further from where we are meant to be.
ex.t: 在正确的事情上失败，会让我们离本该到达的地方更远。

ex.s: Years of experience in the industry - and failed attempts to use technology - have convinced him that the best way to check cattle is with a man on a horse.
ex.t: 多年的行业经验——以及使用技术却失败的尝试——让他确信，检查牛群最好的方式是用一个骑在马上的人。

ex.s: When we fail at the right thing, persistence makes sense.
ex.t: 当我们在正确的事情上失败时，坚持是有意义的。

ex.s: Or will they see the big word “fail” in red?
ex.t: 或者他们会看到那个红色的大字“失败”？

ex.s: So, why did he suddenly force me to do something at which I was sure to fail?
ex.t: 那么，为什么他突然逼我做一件我注定会失败的事？

ex.s: So, why did he suddenly force me to do something at which I was sure to fail?
ex.t: 那么，为什么他突然逼我做一件我注定会失败的事？

ex.s: If you fail, no problem-next time you can fail better!
ex.t: 如果你失败了，没关系——下次你可以“失败”得更漂亮！

ex.s: It's okay to fail, just as long as you learn something that helps you do better next time.
ex.t: 失败没关系，只要你学到能帮助下次做得更好的东西。

ex.s: He said that he failed in a 1_______ contest.
ex.t: 他说他在一次____比赛中失败了。

ex.s: Despite the celebrations, though, in the US the jazz audience continues to shrink and grow older, and the music has failed to connect with younger generations.
ex.t: 尽管如此庆祝，但在美国，爵士乐听众仍在萎缩并老龄化，这种音乐也未能与年轻一代产生共鸣。

ex.s: We invest a lot in roads that help us rush through, but we fail to account for the true costs.
ex.t: 我们在有助于快速通行的道路上投入巨大，但我们未能把真实的成本计算在内。

ex.s: Pedestrians fail to follow the rules.
ex.t: 行人未能遵守规则。

ex.s: Social roles fail to be highlighted.
ex.t: 社会角色未能被凸显。

ex.s: We've all known people who run out of steam before they reach life's halfway mark． I'm not talking about those who fail to get to the top． We can't all get there． I'm talking about people who have stopped learning on growing because they have adopted the fixed attitudes and opinions that all too often come with passing years．
ex.t: 我说的不是那些未能到达顶峰的人。我们不可能都到达那里。我说的是那些因为抱持着随岁月而来的固定态度和看法，而停止学习、停止成长的人。

defs.def: to not do sth 未做；未履行（某事）

ex.s: My heart froze in my chest as I ___43___ the tractor heading towards the ___44___ .I ran desperately but failed to _____45_____.
ex.t: 我的心在胸口一沉，当我____43____拖拉机朝____44____驶来。我拼命地跑，但没能_____45_____。

defs.def: to not pass a test or an exam; to decide that sb/sth has not passed a test or an exam 不及格；评定不及格

ex.s: Then I put the tomatoes and the beaten eggs into pan together.  ＂Not that way，＂ my mom tried to stop us but failed.
ex.t: 然后我把西红柿和打散的鸡蛋一起放进锅里。“不是那样，”妈妈试图阻止我们，但没成功。

ex.s: Each of these views has its value, but if the claim is that any one of these is the scientific method, then they all fail.
ex.t: 这些观点各有价值，但如果声称其中任何一个是科学方法，那么它们就都站不住脚了。

ex.s: I knew then that ____52____ passing or failing tests, studying was about hard work and effort.
ex.t: 那时我明白了，无论____52____是通过还是不及格考试，学习关乎的是努力和付出。

ex.s: I failed, with a low grade.
ex.t: 我不及格了，分数很低。

ex.s: The final exam was Mr Dena's final ____49____ to us, but I failed it.
ex.t: 期末考试是德纳老师给我们的最后____49____，但我没及格。

ex.s: During my second year, I failed my comprehensive exam because my proposal was unclear.
ex.t: 第二年，我综合考试没及格，因为我的开题不清晰。

ex.s: If you forget to officially drop that course, a “F” (Fail) grade will be registered on your record at the end of the term.
ex.t: 如果你忘记正式退课，学期末你的记录上会登记一个“F”（不及格）成绩。

ex.s: I felt he treated me as though I would hold him back and probably make him fail to get an A in the course.
ex.t: 我觉得他对待我，就好像我会拖他后腿，并可能让他在这门课上拿不到A。

defs.def: to stop working 出故障；失灵

ex.s: The card fails to work properly.
ex.t: 这张卡无法正常工作。

ex.s: Sometimes devices fail because a good design is constructed with low quality materials incompetently applied.
ex.t: 有时设备会出故障，因为好的设计用了低质量材料且施工不当。

ex.s: Touch each object you want to touch as if tomorrow your tactile sense would fail.
ex.t: 触摸你想触摸的每个物体，就好像明天你的触觉就会失灵一样。

defs.def: to become weak 尤用于进行时
to disappoint sb; to be unable to help when needed 使失望；有负于；无能为力

ex.s: When he fails to get a ticket.
ex.t: 当他没能买到票时。

ex.s: When he fails to get a ticket.
ex.t: 当他没能买到票时。

defs.def: to not be enough when needed or expected 不足；缺乏
to be unable to continue 倒闭；破产
when you tell sb to do sth without fail, you are telling them that they must do it 务必；一定

ex.s: They may fail to get along.
ex.t: 他们可能没法和睦相处。

ex.s: Though he acknowledges that engineering works can fail because the person who thought them up or engineered them simply got things wrong, in this book Dr Petroski widens his view to consider the larger context in which such failures occur.
ex.t: 尽管他承认，工程结构可能会失效，因为构思或设计它们的人只是搞错了，但在本书中，彼得罗斯基博士拓宽了视野，去考量此类失效发生的更大背景。

ex.s: they send emails in errorB. they fail to work interactively
ex.t: 他们错误地发送邮件 B. 它们无法交互式工作。

ex.s: Friendship soup Like any good soup, This won’t fail to make you smile when you’re feeling down.
ex.t: 友谊汤 就像任何好汤一样，当你心情低落时，它必定会让你露出微笑。
